comment: Every artefact this project installs, pinned to a version and a digest.
download.docker.com publishes no .sha256 sibling (measured: 404), so the digest recorded
here is the one this project states — which is stronger than a checksum served by the same
host as the file it vouches for. Alpine does publish one, and the value below was taken
from it. Bumping a version means replacing the digest in the same commit.
Every URL names a version in its directory too. Alpine's latest-stable/ path serves the
same bytes today and stops serving this file the day 3.25 becomes stable, which turns a
pinned download into a 404 with no code change — so the versioned v3.24/ path is used.
Compose publishes a .sha256 sibling on its release. The value below was not taken from it:
the file was downloaded, hashed here, and the published sibling agreed — so what is recorded
is a digest this project measured and upstream corroborated, which is the stronger of the two.
